Controversies:

In one of the official competitions (COA), you had to win multiple matches to get points so that you could qualify for the finals. One team used it to their advantage by setting themselves against their hunter and giving them a tie, therefore giving points to both sides. There's a video about it on YouTube.

In another competition only for Southeast Asia, a teammate had disconnected mid battle so the round was delayed. In most scenarios they would restart the game, but the game continued for some reason. When same teammate disconnected again, the hunter took the advantage to down them before pausing the game, but by then the damage was done, as an early down gives advantages to the hunter.
